message: 人と魔族
Behind the hectic preparations for KiraFes and the lingering afterglow of its huge success, a shift had begun to appear in the movements of the demons.
Rumors said that mysterious demons--of a different sort from Sally-chan and the Delicious Food Squad--were gathering at Ryuusei Academy.

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, let's see...」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, investigating the academy is one thing, but why are we coming to the shopping district?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Sally-chan and Eauderourke are around here a lot, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure, 'cause Flat-Chest and Ode-ko work part-time at that beef bowl joint.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even outside of work, I see them around this area. Don't you think demons like places where lots of people gather?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why they're drawn to the shopping district and the academy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, maybe demons get lonely more easily than you'd expect... I'm kind of like that myself.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold up. That's way too optimistic. There are plenty of lone wolves among 'em, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then that makes demons even more no different from humans, doesn't it?」
The door to Five-Star Restaurant opens, and Kimura-san appears carrying a plate piled high with steamed Chinese buns.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Kimura-san.」
Being right in front of the food, Kimura-san refrains from speaking and instead sends a smile my way with his eyes.
Using tongs, he transfers the piping-hot buns prepared beforehand in the kitchen into the steamer out front.
Students heading home from the academy and kids out shopping with their moms love buying snacks to eat on the go, so he wouldn't be able to keep up otherwise.

name: Synn
message: 「Kimura-san, thank you for all your help at KiraFes.」
It must have been because I spoke to him. His hand slips, and one of the steamed buns drops right onto Kimura-san's palm.
Kimura-san reflexively waves his hand, sending the steamed bun flying through the air in an arc.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh no, what a waste!」

name: Sally
message: 「Chomp♪」
Sally-chan swoops in and bites into the steamed bun midair.

name: Kim-san
message: 「Nice catch, yes」

name: Sally
message: 「Munch, munch... Phew, this pork bun is so good♪」

name: Kim-san
message: 「I was about to drop that one anyway, so no need to pay, neh」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! Kim-san, toss more of 'em over」

name: Sally
message: 「And if I catch 'em in my mouth like chomp-chomp, it'll be great advertising for your shop!」

name: Kim-san
message: 「It's like a street performance, looks like it'll draw in customers. But playing with food is no good, aru」

name: Sally
message: 「Okaaay」
Having apparently hit it off already, Sally-chan and Kimura-san are deep in friendly conversation. I completely missed my chance to chime in.

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Sally-chan, switch」

name: Sally
message: 「Eeeh~~. Is it that time already?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eaude, eat, meat bun」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, okay, okay. I'll get the money out right now~」

name: Kim-san
message: 「It's fine, it's fine. On the house」

name: Synn
message: 「So Sally-chan is the Ministry of Finance for the Delicious Food Squad」

name: Sally
message: 「Min-is-try of Fi-nance?」

name: Synn
message: 「It means the person who manages the wallet」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep. 'Cause when Oyabin gets hungry, he'll eat literally anything」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eaude, eat, money」

name: Sally
message: 「So usually, I'm the one in charge of handling the money like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Flat-chest here has been secretly embezzling it behind their backs」

name: Sally
message: 「I have not! This is money the Delicious Food Squad earned through sweat and tears!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eaude, trust, Sally-chan」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufu. That's why I love you, Oyabin\s07」

name: Sally
message: 「Though I actually do have a tiny secret stash\s07」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, I'm off to my part-time job!」

name: Synn
message: 「Have a good shiiift」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's really changed...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, totally」
I chatted with Eauderourke for a while. It was the exact same kind of comfort I feel when I'm with everyone from the Student Council.
At the very least, the demons in the Shiokumi Shopping District pose no danger. I became completely convinced of that.
